result.summary: The page is generally well rendered, but horizontally scrollable content is visibly clipped at the right edge, and the lower restaurant card is obscured by the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The horizontal cuisine chip row is cut off on the right, leaving a partially visible next chip with no clear padding or scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add right-side content padding and a deliberate carousel overflow treatment (such as a fade, partial-card cue, or visible scrollbar) so the clipped item looks intentional.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' restaurant carousel is clipped at the right edge: the third restaurant image, name, and delivery text extend beyond the viewport and are truncated.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent carousel gutters and ensure card widths/overflow behavior clearly indicate horizontal scrolling without cutting off important text.

issues.description: The next 'Popular right now' restaurant card is substantially covered by the fixed bottom navigation, so its image and all associated details below the fold are hidden.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding equal to the fixed navigation height plus safe-area spacing, so the final cards can scroll fully above the navigation.
